entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: Predictions from all five major papers[n]suggest the new party will gain three[n]hundred Diet seats...

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: And according to our own public opinion[n]survey, over 80% are in support of[n]Masayoshi Shido.

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: Online polls also seem to point to an[n]overwhelming support for Shido among[n]young people...

entries.speaker: Chief Secretary
entries.en: Isn't there any way to stop this!?

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: We've taken all possible measures, but[n]the media and even the experts have[n]sided with Shido...

entries.speaker: Prime Minister
entries.en: But the Phantom Thieves are the source[n]of all the scandals, not me!

entries.speaker: Prime Minister
entries.en: Why don't the citizens understand that?

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: Well, it is true that the strange cases[n]stopped entirely after the leader of the[n]Thieves died...

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: But rifts have continued to form within[n]the party...

entries.speaker: Chief Secretary
entries.en: Is it because they fear that foolish rumor[n]about how ills will befall those who[n]betray Shido?

entries.speaker: Election Strategist
entries.en: But the truth of the matter is, those[n]suspicious deaths have been taking[n]place for a long time...

entries.speaker: Prime Minister
entries.en: *sigh* It seems there's nothing we can do[n]but resign ourselves to defeat...
